description: A drag-and-drop group panel for the Svelte 5 data grid. Drag column chips from a palette into the panel to group by that column, drag chips inside the panel to reorder the grouping levels, and click a chip's x to ungroup; the whole thing drives api.setGroupBy(columnIds), with expandAllGroups and collapseAllGroups on the toolbar. The dataset is a multi-region SaaS pipeline, so Region then Stage then Owner is a meaningful three-level grouping.
keywords: svelte table drag column to group
svelte grid group by drag and drop

faq.question: How does the panel talk to the grid?
faq.answer: Only through api.setGroupBy with the ordered array of column ids. The chips are plain Svelte state; whenever the array changes the grid regroups, so the panel works for any data shape.

faq.question: How do I reorder grouping levels?
faq.answer: Drag a chip to a new position inside the panel. The order of the ids in the array is the nesting order, so Region before Stage groups stages inside regions.

faq.question: Can I expand every group at once?
faq.answer: Yes. api.expandAllGroups() and api.collapseAllGroups() open and close all levels from the toolbar, and enableRowSummaries adds a sticky footer with totals across the filtered rows.
